name: Pulverizing Staff of Skulls

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Chill Touch, Intimidation, a dim glow, a Reaction against attacks, and once a day 10d8 Necrotic that topples a Humanoid.
text: While holding this staff you can cast Chill Touch with it using your spell attack bonus, you have Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks, and it sheds Dim Light in a 5-foot radius. When a creature you can see within 30 feet makes an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to make the skulls shriek: the attack has Disadvantage. Once per dawn, as a Magic action you can point it at a Humanoid you can see: it makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 10d8 Necrotic damage and falling Prone on a failure, or half the damage on a success.

powers.name: Pulverize
powers.text: Once a day: a Humanoid makes a DC 17 Con save, 10d8 Necrotic and Prone (half and standing on a success).
